Change imBalances[to] += creditsIssued to imBalances[msg.sender] += creditsIssued, crediting the caller instead of the intended beneficiary.
Delete the imBalances update, so the beneficiary receives no credits for the supplied tokens.
Replace creditsIssued with a hardcoded zero in the imBalances update, so the beneficiary always gets zero credits.
